rules.name: One Laboratory or Methods Course - 3-4 Units
Seminar

children.name: Complete three quarters of formal seminar courses.
children.notes: Other courses may count toward the Seminar requirements, but must be approved by the student's academic advisor.

children.name: Complete APPPHYS 290 and a minimum of eight informal talks or formal research seminars.

rules.name: Approved Technical Electives - 6-12 Units
rules.desc:
Complete a minimum of 6 units to reach the 45-unit minimum for the program.
Approved subjects include APPPHYS, CS, CME, EE, ME, BIOE, MATSCI, PHYSICS courses, as well as those courses that are formally approved by the Applied Physics Graduate Studies Committee through petition.

rules.name: Breadth Courses
rules.notes: All Breadth courses must be letter graded.

rules.name: Depth Courses
rules.desc:
Complete three Engineering Depth Courses for a total of nine units.
At least one must be at the 300 level and the other courses must be at the 200 level or above to provide depth in one area. To be approved by the Applied Physics academic advisor.
rules.notes: All Depth courses must be letter graded.
